hero.description: I build and ship production software end-to-end: SaaS dashboards, booking platforms, secure APIs, and the systems underneath them. In ~5 years I've gone deep on React, Next.js, Laravel, and Node, mentoring juniors and talking to international clients along the way.

about.label: About
about.title: Backend depth, front-end polish, and end-to-end ownership.
paragraphs: I'm Samir, a senior full-stack developer based in Surat, India. I started with PHP and web apps, then moved into product work: shipping SaaS, travel platforms, legal-tech, and cybersecurity tools for teams across the US, UK, and beyond.

I'm currently a Sr. Laravel Backend Developer at Sassy Infotech, working on pencila.ai and leading one developer alongside my own delivery. Before that I led full-stack work at Logix Built Solution: React, Laravel, Node, client calls, and mentoring juniors. I'm comfortable in complex existing codebases. I stabilize them, speed them up, or take an MVP to something that scales.
I care about clear communication, maintainable code, and shipping on a predictable cadence.
